purpose: Create the offline macOS ISO artifacts maintained by this repository.
notes: Read the current image-production scripts and platform requirements. Verify the exact macOS version and output checksums; ISO creation is not proof that the guest boots on every host.
purpose_zh: 按当前脚本制作离线 macOS ISO 并核对版本及校验值。
notes_zh: 核对当前制作脚本、平台要求、macOS 版本及输出校验值。ISO 制作完成不等于已验证所有宿主机都可启动该系统。
